title: Unable to find the native method bind. (Method 'Viewport.notify_mouse_entered')
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.4 stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Fedora Linux 41 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 565.77) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads)

### Issue description

The game runs fine when playing on editor mode, no errors thrown. However, trying to get World3D or anything related to the viewport (such as GetViewport().GetWorld3D() or GetViewport().GetCamera3D()) on the Release build shows the following error:

```
ERROR: System.TypeInitializationException: The type initializer for 'Godot.Viewport' threw an exception.
 ---> Godot.GodotObject+NativeMethodBindNotFoundException: Unable to find the native method bind. (Method 'Viewport.notify_mouse_entered')
   at Godot.GodotObject.ClassDB_get_method_with_compatibility(StringName type, StringName method, UInt64 hash)
   at Godot.Viewport..cctor()
   --- End of inner exception stack trace ---
   at Godot.Viewport.GetWorld3D()
   at Blokoto.Lib.Managers.SettingsManager.SetGraphicsPreset(GraphicsPreset preset)
   at Blokoto.Lib.Managers.SettingsManager._EnterTree()
   at Godot.Node.InvokeGodotClassMethod(godot_string_name& method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret)
   at Blokoto.Lib.Managers.SettingsManager.InvokeGodotClassMethod(godot_string_name& method, NativeVariantPtrArgs args, godot_variant& ret)
   at Godot.Bridge.CSharpInstanceBridge.Call(IntPtr godotObjectGCHandle, godot_string_name* method, godot_variant** args, Int32 argCount, godot_variant_call_error* refCallError, godot_variant* ret)
   at: void Godot.NativeInterop.ExceptionUtils.LogException(System.Exception) (:0)
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Export the C# game as a Release build using the latest 4.4 export templates downloaded from the engine

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A
